entities.name: Antonio Maria Cadolini

entities.summary: Antonio Maria Cadolini was an Italian Roman Catholic prelate who served as bishop of the Diocese of Cesena from 1822 to 1838 and bishop of the Diocese of Ancona e Numana from 1838 to his death in 1851.
